Lane description: Native v1.44 measure on union-774: 775/785 raw 211, +0x2ba60 create_pool::execute (1229/1229 insns, plain masked diff 0), 0 normalized and 0 raw losses, no Stack offset warnings, no new warnings. Linux expected 780/785. Changes (create_pool.rs + utils/token.rs only): (1) port of the fz-A-pool-r1 best partial (mg-A-2 field-by-field Pool writes, canonical via utils::pool_authority, 'let bump = ctx.bumps.pool;' scalar, liquidity/clock forms) onto u774 (create_pool.rs identical in u768 and u774). (2) NEW: quote check 'let quote_supported = if canonical { supported_mint_account(&a.quote_mint, true) } else { supported_mint_account(&a.quote_mint, false) }; require!(quote_supported, UnsupportedQuoteMint);' with a new helper appended at the END of utils/token.rs: 'pub fn supported_mint_account(mint: &InterfaceAccount<Mint>, allow_extensions: bool) -> bool { supported_mint(mint.as_ref(), allow_extensions) }'. Mechanism: the pub (hidden-linkage) helper is not MIR-inlined and not ArgPromoted; LLVM inlines it per arm with a noalias.scope.decl, which stops SimplifyCFG from hoisting the [quote_mint+0x58] AccountInfo load out of the arms (orig keeps it per arm). The helper symbol is not in the final .so. (3) NEW: 'require!(a.global_config.disable_flags & 1 != 1, DisabledCreatePool)' (was '& 1 == 0'; same semantics): the MIR switch polarity makes its error block codegen early, so rustc creates the function's return block before the quote head instead of between the head and the quote arms (block placement then lays the canonical arm inline and the non-canonical arm far, as in the original). Behaviour: same checks, errors (codes, names, lines), events and CPI order; quote supported_mint called with the same (mint, canonical) values. Positioning devices: comment-only '//' lines in instructions/create_pool.rs at lines 165-170, 172-176, 180-181, 184-188, 195-197, 202-213, 261-273, 282-289, 332-338 (61 lines, place require!/error! macros on original lines; file stays 369 lines); no #[inline(always)], no file moves. The cold()/likely()/unlikely() helpers of the r1 partial are not used and were removed.
